svg.data-input-ac: single-phase 230 V, L1 L2/N PE. The SKU sheet for C3B36RL-EPJE0AT4 prints 230 V, 32 A (32 A rated), 7.3 kW and an IEC 230V/32A 2P+PE 6h plug.
svg.data-breakers: two two-pole branch breakers, 10 kAIC North America, 5 kAIC rest of world (SKU sheet)

g.data-description: Breaker 1 of 2, a two-pole branch breaker across L1 and L2/N (the schematic's label), feeding outlets 1 to 18
g.title: breaker-1

g.data-description: Breaker 2 of 2, a two-pole branch breaker across L1 and L2/N (the schematic's label), feeding outlets 19 to 36
g.title: breaker-2
